evidence: The recorded original/cached same-view GPU RGBA hashes and CPU pixels are identical. The static cached moving-camera frame submits zero shadow triangles while preserving map identity and fixed light-space matrix.
scope: First complete beauty frame refreshes shadows after initialization probes; AO normal rendering cannot overwrite the map with a reduced-visibility scene.
limit: This establishes the bounded cache behavior, not complete flicker-free cinematography or photographic fidelity. Cold compilation and warm frame timings are not used as a speedup ratio.
